- Lower: p, b, N, Y

- Lower rectangle: GREEN border

- Green rectangle: colors close to green → N, b, Y, p (green, blue, yellow, purple)

- Red rectangle: R, p, Y (red, purple, yellow - alternating?)
- Green rectangle: O, b, N, M (orange, blue, green, magenta)

That doesn't work.

- Lower (odd): O(1), R(3), N(5), M(7) - 4 colors ✓
This fits! Let me try upper=p,b,Y; lower=O,R,N,M.

- Lower: O, R, N, M
